outcome: Active Elastic is a normal Showcase/catalog Experiment instead of a privileged Built-in execution path
owner_impact: The canonical Active Elastic example keeps the same scientific controller, initialization, runtime values and live metrics, but the Lab now loads it through the generic Experiment catalog/artifact path. Built-in-specific registry state, save/copy compatibility, result identity and Metrics injection are removed.

next.text: Epic continues with #483 — Product Design: coherent scalable Experiment Library. That design-only ticket will start in a later owner turn and will define the final Showcase / Mine / Shared / Supervised library navigation before #480 implements it.

technical_evidence: The browser bootstrap uses a generic Experiment catalog descriptor containing Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics artifacts.

Active Elastic configuration now exposes the generic runtime contract aliases INTERACTION_RADIUS, MAX_FORWARD_SPEED and MAX_ANGULAR_SPEED with values identical to the previous browser-only compatibility mapping.
Registry/current-source state uses explicit catalog source identity rather than null/builtin semantics.
Metrics load through the generic artifact application path; the dedicated Active Elastic Metrics installer modules are removed.
Local result provenance records stable catalog source identity instead of the synthetic builtin ID.
Showcase catalog source identity is normalized to catalog:active-elastic while retaining the generic Showcase source-key mechanism.
